headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 26, 2026**
article:
The Kansas City Royals edged out the Detroit Tigers in a close matchup, securing a 3-2 win behind Hao-Yu Lee's standout performance, which included 2 home runs and 2 RBIs. The Washington Nationals took down the Arizona Diamondbacks 5-3, led by CJ Abrams' 3 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. The San Francisco Giants dominated the Los Angeles Angels 9-2, with Robbie Ray earning the win after pitching 6.0 innings with 5 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, affecting their teams' lineups. Cody Bellinger, the left fielder for the New York Yankees, has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left hamstring strain. Other notable injuries include Shea Langeliers (torn meniscus in right knee) and Mike Paredes (left oblique strain).

The MLB trade market has seen several transactions. The Boston Red Sox traded LHP Connelly Early to the Washington Nationals for 3B Curtis Mead. The Kansas City Royals traded CF Kameron Misner to the Philadelphia Phillies for cash. The San Diego Padres traded RHP Ron Marinaccio to the Pittsburgh Pirates for future considerations. The Houston Astros traded RHP Nate Pearson to the Kansas City Royals for RHP Max Martin.

top_news.title: **Royals Take Down Tigers in Thrilling 3-2 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals edged out the Detroit Tigers in a close matchup, securing a 3-2 win. Hao-Yu Lee led the Royals' offense with a standout performance, hitting 2 home runs and driving in 2 runs.

top_news.title: **Nationals Take Down Diamondbacks 5-3**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a 3-5 victory over the Arizona Diamondbacks, with CJ Abrams leading the offense with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. Foster Griffin earned the win, while Clayton Beeter secured the save.

top_news.title: **Giants Rout Angels 9-2**
top_news.summary: The San Francisco Giants dominated the Los Angeles Angels, winning 9-2 behind a strong performance from Robbie Ray, who earned the win with 6.0 innings pitched, 5 strikeouts, and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Shut Out Red Sox 6-0**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays dominated the Boston Red Sox, securing a 6-0 victory behind a strong performance from Dylan Cease. Cease pitched 9.0 innings, striking out 12 batters and allowing just 1 hit.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down Guardians in Close Match**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays edged out the Cleveland Guardians 1-0 in a low-scoring game. Impact performances came from Parker Messick and Drew Rasmussen on the mound, while Chandler Simpson stood out at the plate.

top_news.title: **Yankees Place Cody Bellinger on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Cody Bellinger, the left fielder for the New York Yankees, has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left hamstring strain.

top_news.title: **Red Sox Acquire Curtis Mead in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox have made a move to bolster their roster, trading LHP Connelly Early to the Washington Nationals in exchange for 3B Curtis Mead.
